note: The earlier residual is closed. New TestRFC7296MismatchedResponderSPIReachesNoSAThroughTheReceiveLoops runs the real receive loops over loopback UDP, dispatchInbound (port 500) and dispatchNATTInbound (non-ESP marker): a datagram with the established SA's initiator SPI and a different non-zero responder SPI, sent first, is never delivered to the SA's session (the first delivered datagram must carry the SA's own responder SPI, and no second one arrives); the datagram with the full pair is delivered. Ordering on loopback and the single dispatch goroutine make 'not delivered' distinguishable from 'delayed'. Kept: lookupInbound units TestRFC7296IKESPIPairIdentifiesTheIKESA / TestRFC7296UnknownIKESPIPairMapsToNoSA (full-pair map, zero-rSPI exceptions) and wire header round-trip/short-header tags. Records: dispatchInbound, dispatchNATTInbound, lookupInbound reverts observed red.
